title: Crossed-product recognition and injective cores
scope: Crossed-product recognition, corners, trace normalization, factorial-centralizer spectra and the injective type III-lambda reduction. PC9 proves norm-one retractions and injectivity; PC10 proves invariant-state finite classification; PC11 supplies tracial quotients, normal constant embeddings, finite unitary lifting and bounded trace expectations without factoriality or separability assumptions.

authors.contribution: Companion exposition, exact prerequisite interfaces, trace normalization and PC7–PC8 factorial-centralizer spectral proof. Full unital C*-algebra norm-one retraction proof and the representation-independent injectivity criterion. Invariant-state finite classification and exact finite-model, balanced-coupling and dyadic uniqueness synthesis. Tracial specialization, whole-domain normal embedding and bounded expectations with finite central comparison.
